faq.q: What counts as a hosted word?
faq.a: A hosted word is any word in your source language stored in Lingrove. Translations into target locales are not counted, so adding a language never changes your word count.

faq.q: Can we bring our own translators or vendors?
faq.a: Yes. Invite in-house linguists or connect your existing language service providers. Lingrove also offers vetted professional translators billed per word, if you need them.
Every plan includes machine translation with your glossary applied. Business and Enterprise can also connect their own engine accounts.
Most teams connect a repository and ship their first translated pull request within a day. Enterprise onboarding, including SSO and memory imports, typically takes one to two weeks.

faq.q: Do you offer discounts for non-profits and education?
faq.a: Yes, 40% off any annual plan for registered non-profits and accredited education institutions.
